short_description: New Horizons Multispectral Visible Imaging Camera (MVIC) filters

licence.terms: "generally are not subject to copyright in the United States" "You may use this material for educational or informational purposes" "NASA should be acknowledged as the source of the material"
licence.scope: NASA website media usage guidelines (owner's website terms, option 2; the page does not serve the curves). They cover NASA images, audio, video and media files, not filter-transmission tables explicitly; they say such NASA material is generally not subject to copyright in the US and asks that NASA be acknowledged. SVO cites Reuter et al. 2008 (arXiv:0709.4281, whose abstract page links http://arxiv.org/licenses/assumed-1991-2003/; that covers the article, not the numbers) and the New Horizons PDS calibration files (pds-smallbodies.astro.umd.edu, nh-p-mvic-3-pluto-v3.0/calib/spectra); the NASA terms were used as the owner's statement. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
